# Ndubuisi Marvellous

> Social media strategy, growth, and community lead for fintech, Web3, and tech brands scaling across emerging markets, with deep experience across Africa. 5+ years of experience, 40M+ organic views and impressions, 150K+ new followers and members gained, 20K+ users attributed to ambassador program.

Ndubuisi Marvellous (thesocialduke) drives social media strategy, community growth, and content for crypto, fintech, SaaS, and emerging tech brands, with a focus on African markets. Past and current work includes Bitget, Binance, and Coinbase (Base).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/): overview, background, and stats.
- [Services](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/services): open to work. Social media strategy, community-led growth (using community to acquire, activate and retain users), partnerships & ecosystem growth (creators, KOLs, ambassadors, partners), and offline events. Four-step process: understand the business, build the strategy, execute with the team, measure and improve.
- [Bitget case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/bitget) (Bitget is a top-10 global crypto exchange by CoinGecko's trust ranking): led social media and community for Bitget across multiple African markets, starting from a target of 10,000+ new followers a month that he met with KOL partnerships, organic campaigns and giveaways, riding regional token trends, and working with business development (the business developer he worked with generated $20M to $30M in monthly trade volume): 40M+ organic views and impressions, 150K+ new followers and members gained, 20K+ users attributed to ambassador program, plus the community operating model and map (B2C channels and B2B relationships: Bitget Builders ambassadors, 100+ KOLs and creators, 200+ P2P merchants, partner events), and, when OKX announced its exit from Nigeria, he led Bitget's social and community response (community, PR, external partners and KOLs); Bitget Wallet then reached #1 in Nigeria's app-store rankings and "Bitget" trended nationally. Also: core programs, community events across Nigeria, Kenya and Ethiopia that he sponsored, mostly hosted himself and ran on an events guide and standard operating structure he wrote; an Education section (he launched the Bitget Africa YouTube channel and grew it to about 2,000 subscribers; B2B merchant onboarding and VIP partner sessions) with live sessions he hosted on the Bitget Africa YouTube channel (market updates such as the NFP report and gold, forex & CFD markets; a VIP session; product updates on Bitget P2P institutional merchants, US stock futures and CFD trading) ; creator-led explainer videos made with a Ghanaian creator (KOL), to which he contributed scripting and creative direction (Bitget TradFi, Spot Auto Invest, US stocks from Africa, P2P safety in Nigeria, market basics, OpenAI pre-IPO access); and #BitQuest, a 7-day gamified learn & earn campaign on X; and educational articles ranking on Google (How to Buy Crypto via P2P Using OPay in Nigeria, How to Buy Crypto in Kenya with M-Pesa on Bitget P2P, How to Buy Crypto in Ethiopia Using Telebirr on Bitget P2P) with highlight videos (P2P Merchant Connect Lagos, Merchant Meetup Nairobi, Crypto Experience Month at the University of Nairobi, Ethiopia Blockchain Week, El Clasico Watch Party Lagos, Community Meetup Nairobi).
- [Base (Coinbase) case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/base-southern-africa) (Base is Coinbase's Ethereum layer 2, second only to Ethereum among blockchains by DeFi value locked, per DefiLlama): turned Base's Southern Africa creator network, which had creators (some paid) but little usable output, into a steady source of on-brand content: a creator guide, kickoff call and editorial calendar for publishing (which also gave Base's social media lead a structure for their work and a clear view to share with stakeholders), before/after coaching on each creator's videos, reference videos he produced, and AI films and short videos (an idea from Base's regional lead that he developed from early experiments into finished concepts he wrote and directed) used in regional promotion.
- [Binance case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/binance-africa) (Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by trading volume and a top-3 exchange by CoinGecko's trust ranking): making complex products easier to understand. Street interviews keep showing up near the top of crypto exchanges' social pages, and across 21,037 TikToks analysed by Revid they pulled about 2.2x the median views of talking-head videos, so Binance Africa brought him on as a content creator to take crypto to the street (plus educational content across the region): unscripted interviews built on one simple crypto question each, posted on Instagram and TikTok, drawing tens of thousands of views per episode (e.g. 'Gold or Bitcoin?' 40.3K) and growing followers on both.

Replies within 8 hours; available to relocate.
